name: image_apply_finMulAntidiag
statement: ℕ} {i : Fin d} (hd : d ≠ 1) : (finMulAntidiag d n).image (fun f => f i) = divisors n

name: primeFactorsPiBij_surj
statement: ℕ) (hn : Squarefree n) (t : Fin d → ℕ) (ht : t ∈ finMulAntidiag d n) : ∃ (g : _) (hg : g ∈ pi n.primeFactors fun _ => univ), Nat.primeFactorsPiBij d n g hg = t

name: f_surj
statement: ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (b : ℕ × ℕ) (hb : b ∈ Finset.filter (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => x.lcm y = n) (n.divisors ×ˢ n.divisors)) : ∃ (a : Fin 3 → ℕ) (ha : a ∈ finMulAntidiag 3 n), f a ha = b
